title: Ankhorage Scraper
summary: Captures safe, bounded browser observations of public websites for recognition workflows.
purpose: Provide deterministic website observations through a reusable package and CLI without exposing unbounded browser automation.
responsibilities: Crawl public website URLs within explicit limits and emit portable observation documents.
Expose crawl behavior through package, CLI, capability, and public-type entrypoints.
Apply bounded navigation and browser-resource handling around Puppeteer.
boundaries: Does not decide how observation documents are recognized or rendered.
Does not own browser installation, network availability, or downstream migration policy.
Does not provide unrestricted general-purpose browser automation.
audience: Recognition pipelines that require portable observations of public websites.
CLI users inspecting a website before downstream processing.
useCases: Capture a bounded observation document from a public URL.
Run the same crawl boundary through the standalone CLI.
Advertise scraper capabilities to Ankh-compatible tooling.

architecture.role: Tooling package and CLI adapter around bounded Puppeteer observation.
invariants: Observation output uses published portable Contracts types.
Crawls remain bounded by explicit policy rather than ambient browser behavior.
Package and CLI entrypoints share the same observation boundary.

limitations: Requires browser and network access to the requested public site.
Website defenses, robots policy, redirects, and dynamic behavior can limit observable content.
